concept.title: Red Hat Quay enhanced build architecture
concept.shortdesc: Red Hat Quay enhanced build architecture uses a build manager that creates Job objects and unprivileged pods running the quay-builder image. The build manager coordinates status and image builds through the quay-builder binary and Podman inside each pod.

conbody.p: The following image shows the expected design flow and architecture of the enhanced build features:

With this enhancement, the build manager first creates the Job Object. Then, the Job Object then creates a pod using the quay-builder-image. The quay-builder-image contains the quay-builder binary and the Podman service. The created pod runs as unprivileged. The quay-builder binary then builds the image while communicating status and retrieving build information from the Build Manager.
